title: Which large groups carry the growing end into later rounds?
claim: Does the multi-block, low-replacement structure at start-03 reproduce indefinitely under the funded parity law, and which of the sixteen jump-selected starts can be proved to end or never end?
standard_statement: Mark the least number of old maximal blocks covering a large legal group and the members individually replaceable by a junction outside it. Test witnesses for cover at least three and fraction at most 3/2000, with the group size reported. A next-round reproduction certificate must certify a strictly larger group and the specified replacement bound on the whole stage. An infinite conclusion requires an invariant propagated under the whole lawful rule. In graph language the operator takes a funded edge-clique cover and forms its intersection graph, deleting held maximal cliques and retaining uncovered edges and singleton leaves. Test whether a separated automorphism, an edge-walk invariant, or a pendant with two fresh labels is preserved by that operation.
prior_work: HUB-GUIDED-SAMPLE gives the complete sector 13/4 and weighted group marks. The earlier PARTNER-RETRACT witness closes despite two successful lifts. PARTNER-SEVEN screens entire partnered ends, REDUCE-BLOCKS supplies the hub form, WALL-READ the partnered induction and MERGE-BURST the binomial tail. EXPLOSIVE measured the filled initial maps; a reached parent incidence requires a proof of transport. The classical clique operator preserves triangular fundamental groups, and coaffine automorphisms have been studied there. Our proofs check the edge-cover, singleton, capacity and closure hypotheses directly. The relay identification treats the special presentations where group size is bounded; the new test is local to a reached roster even amid unrestricted overlaps.
source_contribution: Exact parents and shared parents of groups, old-block cover and literal replacements. Universal persistence by components, filled walks or renamings separating every junction from its image. Compare the one-block closing theorem with fully funded examples having the same local profile.
remaining_obligations: Prove start-03 never ends, prove it ends, or isolate the exact missing intersection or induction statement after testing both possibilities on the specified sector and all sixteen starts. An observed sample supplies a witnessed group, never a verdict on infinite growth.
completion_gate: Prove each scoped assertion and report unrestricted status.
